newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela PdVSA to aquire 100 pct of UNOVEN.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela PdVSA to aquire 100 pct of UNOVEN.

text.p: Venezuelan state-owned oil company PdVSA said Thursday it had signed a letter of intent to buy out its partner's Union Oil of America's 50 percent stake in the UNO-VEN refining complex in the United States.

"This letter of intent will give (to PdVSA) full control of all the refining assets," PdVSA said in a press release. UNOVEN has installed refining capacity of 153,000 barrels per day (bpd) of light crudes, of which PdVSA curently supplies some 135,000 bpd.

UNOVEN's Lemont Illinois refinery, in which PdVSA took a 50 percent share in 1989, produces 53 percent gasoline, five percent jet fuel, 24 percent diesel and 18 percent industrial and petrochemical products.

The agreement, which is expected to be formally closed in March, will strengthen PdVSA's "position in its principal market," the release said, and presents new opportunities for U.S. based PdVSA subsidiary Citgo.
UNOVEN products are currently retailed throughout the U.S. under the "76" chain which has 14 terminals, 60 fully-owned gasoline stations and 2,000 independents, the release said.
